findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Procurement.Rules.mayIssuePo matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: exemption shape '||' on "V-0417" (line 11): no cited record and no accepted exception record names "V-0417"; category test '= "V-0417"' (line 11): no accepted record names "V-0417". A category exemption lets one category bypass the rule; an exemption needs its own decision record, whatever the code comments call it. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
